item.title: Port Houston tonnage rises 4% as officials cut reefer free time
item.description: Port Houston officials passed a new rule set to take effect May 1 aimed at pressing shippers to move refrigerated cargo faster.

item.title: How much jail time for the Louisiana staged truck accident attorneys?
item.description: The convicted lawyers in the Louisiana staged accident case will be sentenced in July. How much will they receive?

item.title: Fraud and Loathing in the Mojave Desert
item.description: Danielle Spinelli’s CHP ride-along exposes massive Mojave Desert rail cargo theft. Broken seals, shoelace markers and 40-man crews turn California’s remote freight trains into a sophisticated theft playground.

item.title: FMC's DiBella: Ports are key to U.S. economic security and stability
item.description: New Federal Maritime Commission Chair Laura DiBella says the Trump administration is making the strongest push in decades to support the domestic shipping industry.

item.title: Samsara introduces 2026 North America Customer Advisory Board
item.description: Samsara announced its 2026 Customer Advisory Board with leaders from Old Dominion, Werner, XPO and nearly 40 fleets. The group is shaping next-gen AI safety tools like Samsara Coach ahead of the Beyond conference.

item.title: Airlines Were Always the Answer, and One Platform Is Proving It
item.description: IAG Cargo has launched deliver-e, a cross-border parcel delivery platform that leverages airline networks to offer faster, more transparent international e-commerce shipping with three-to-six-day transit times across 250+ destinations.

item.title: California ports ask state for $1B for infrastructure in FY2027
item.description: California ports are requesting $1 billion in the fiscal 2027 budget to fund infrastructure, modernization and supply chain readiness across the state's 11 deep-water hubs.

item.title: Hub Group gets Nasdaq notice for financial filing delay
item.description: Hub Group said it received a deficiency notice from Nasdaq for failing to timely submit 2025 financial results after discovering an accounting error.

item.title: FedEx to compete in same-day delivery with Amazon, Walmart and UPS
item.description: FedEx is launching same-day delivery through a partnership with OneRail, a final-mile platform.

item.title: Raising the trucking insurance minimum is overdue
item.description: The $750,000 federal minimum set in 1980 has lost 70% of its purchasing power and covers a fraction of what a serious crash costs today.

item.title: Cutting-edge sensor tech targets cargo theft as losses hit $725M
item.description: As cargo theft grows more sophisticated, real-time, item-level tracking could help shippers detect theft and supply chain breakdowns before freight disappears.

item.title: Clearinghouse fraud putting drugged drivers back on the road
item.description: One in eight return-to-duty clearances in the FMCSA Clearinghouse may be fraudulent. This is the network that made it possible.

item.title: Transload provider bringing new life to dormant Maine rail lines
item.description: In Maine, a rail services company is making plans to restart freight services on dormant lines.

item.title: SONAR and Prodensus Partner to Help Freight Brokers Win More Business, Before the Competition Even Responds
item.description: New integration puts real-time market intelligence directly into the hands of reps processing freight RFPs, cutting response time from hours to minutes.

item.title: Echo Global Logistics expands platform with ITS acquisition
item.description: Echo Global Logistics announced it has completed its acquisition of ITS Logistics, creating a $5.2 billion, full-service supply chain services platform.
